rule: Use one primary action per view and make secondary actions visually subordinate.
Use a consistent spacing scale; do not invent unrelated gaps per component.
Keep text and controls readable against their actual surfaces; verify contrast instead of guessing.
Keep a visible keyboard focus treatment that is not a blue browser-like rectangle unless it is intentionally part of the design.
Make touch targets comfortably usable and keep adjacent actions separated.
Interactive elements need explicit idle, hover, focus, pressed, disabled, loading, success, and error states when applicable.
Show where work is happening without replacing the whole interface with an unnecessary spinner.
Empty states explain what is missing and expose the next useful action.
Errors identify the failed action, preserve user input when possible, and offer recovery.
Long labels and localized text must wrap or reflow without clipping controls.
Design narrow, medium, and wide layouts as intentional compositions rather than shrinking desktop CSS.
Motion should explain causality or confirm feedback; it must not delay semantic completion.
Respect reduced-motion preferences and keep all essential state changes understandable without animation.
Use semantic controls and accessible names; do not turn ordinary text or containers into fake buttons.
Use one coherent icon family and ensure icons support meaning rather than decorate every label.
Match visual density to task frequency and information volume; dense tools need compact but readable rhythm.
Use elevation and borders to establish hierarchy; do not give every container its own card treatment.
Use a deliberate heading/body pairing and keep body text readable at normal scale.
Align numeric content consistently and use tabular or monospaced numerals when scanning accuracy matters.
Avoid trapping primary content behind nested scroll containers without a clear reason.
Destructive actions need clear labels, confirmation when appropriate, and a recoverable path when feasible.
Every user action that changes state should produce immediate, perceivable feedback.
